source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, adhyaya 1

lines.text: Before the war. Before the dice. Before any throne was fought for…
lines.note: beats = word indices of the three 'Before's: ghost flashes + drum hits land on them

lines.text: …a storyteller walked into the Naimisha forest.
His name was Ugrashravas, son of Lomaharshana.
lines.note: beats[0] = word index of the name: the gold lettering lands on it

lines.text: There, for twelve years, sages had tended a sacred fire.
They asked him for one story — the one he heard at King Janamejaya's great sacrifice.
lines.note: beats[0] = word index where the court vision begins to form in the smoke

lines.text: The story composed by Vyasa. The Mahabharatam.
lines.note: beats[0] = word index of the title word: the gold title blooms on it; hold = extra seconds after the voice
spoken over the end card, which shows strings.episodeLabel / episodeTitle instead of a caption
